regions.finding: Two distinct optically active runs were retained: (R)-1r (99.5% ee) to (R)-5ra (70%, 99% ee) and (R)-1s (>99% ee) to (R)-5sa (63%, >99% ee), each at 1.0 mmol with 4a 1.2 equiv, Pd(PPh3)4 5 mol%, K2CO3 3 equiv, DMSO, 70 °C, 11 h.

The 1t/4a reaction was retained as one symmetric double-triple-cyclization experiment: 1t 0.2 mmol at 0.025 M, 4a 2.4 equiv, Pd(PPh3)4 10 mol%, K2CO3 6 equiv, DMSO, 70 °C/12 h, product 5ta in 46% isolated yield, constructing six rings.
